items.title: Bosshogg Macaroni is live! Classic. I'm working and networking

chunks.text: Keep the earning motion when the noise is loud. Bills, kids, and a hard week do not pause the work. You still find the next way to get paid. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zYQg4KGpYQ&t=77

If money is tight, get a skill you can sell. If direct selling feels too harsh, learn promotion. Work you can measure will feel cold. That cold is how results get made. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zYQg4KGpYQ&t=220

If one part of the job scares you, the income can still come from the conversation. Have a line ready before you knock. Outreach volume can put you ahead of people who only wait to be trained. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zYQg4KGpYQ&t=291

Give the next few paychecks a job before you spend them on a mood. A place, a way to get around, and clothes for the work. Stay long enough to get situated, then check the spending. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zYQg4KGpYQ&t=500

The week may not be going your way. Do not wear it. People who are already struggling stay away from a struggle they can see. Still show up and ask, as if the slump is not the story. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zYQg4KGpYQ&t=780

Slow motion beats no motion. That line came from a man named Jimmy. Credit who you learned it from, then make it yours. If you are not moving, people treat you as finished. Get ready and go meet people. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zYQg4KGpYQ&t=887

A goal tells you what to do with a new connection. Build the place before they arrive, or you will meet the right person and not know what to do with them. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zYQg4KGpYQ&t=910

You cannot ask if you have nothing to offer. There is no money without a business and a reason. Do not fund laziness. Bring the offer, then ask. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zYQg4KGpYQ&t=1020

Come in with a question, or the talk is aimed at you instead of with you. This work is not cute. If that is not what you came for, the room is not yours. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zYQg4KGpYQ&t=1059

Put something into a real asset, stocks or a place, instead of performing being cheap. The point is money with a job, not a show of how little you can live on. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zYQg4KGpYQ&t=1156

Paycheck to paycheck can still be the exit. A few months of steady grind can change the setup. Most people do not stay with the practice a year. The ones who do are the ones the work changes. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zYQg4KGpYQ&t=1204
Life does not get easier by itself. You make it easier. Waiting for things to finish breaking is not a plan. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zYQg4KGpYQ&t=1278
Rising above a petty fight is the proof, not winning it. A bad moment at a store is not worth losing who your people need you to be. Back up. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zYQg4KGpYQ&t=2002

Show up ready to work where people can see you, and you will meet someone ready to work with you. Tell the truth about who you are early, instead of inventing a softer self so they will stay. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zYQg4KGpYQ&t=2549
You do not need a new inspiring line every day. Use the one you already have, with people who are actually using it. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zYQg4KGpYQ&t=2883

People you respect may name the thing you left sitting, and you may name theirs. If you have to talk someone into the work, you already lost. Introduce what you do. If it does not call them, let them go. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zYQg4KGpYQ&t=3063

A person can go back to school at 60, dislike the middle, and still come out with a credential the children can see. A credential is a visible backup when the harder sales path is not theirs. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zYQg4KGpYQ&t=3156
A higher wage follows a higher-value skill. People pay for the value you can actually deliver. Bring more than one thing to the table. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zYQg4KGpYQ&t=3257
Two clients is already the work. Do not hide it inside a fancy name. Name what you actually do, then do more of that. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zYQg4KGpYQ&t=3348
